title: PresetCatalog
description: The injectable, normalized preset-route catalog for @offtrailstudio/transit-mapper. A strict projection of the editor's TransitMapData: a shared stop table plus routes whose ordered sequences live in patterns. Keep in sync with PresetCatalog in src/lib/presets/catalog.ts. A schemaVersion-1 payload (flat stops embedded per route) is still accepted and auto-upgraded by the loader.

schemaVersion.description: Catalog shape version. The editor rejects a payload whose value it doesn't understand (v1 is upgraded, v2 is native).

version.description: Semver of the content (new routes = minor, coordinate fixes = patch, schema bump = major).

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when this snapshot was built.

stops.description: Shared stop table (GTFS stops.txt); patterns reference these by id.

defaultRouteType.description: Transit mode every route in this group adopts unless it sets its own routeType.

PresetPattern.description: One ordered stop sequence a route runs — GTFS trip pattern. patterns[0] is primary.

name.description: Optional variant label (GTFS trip_headsign-ish), e.g. "via Airport".

stopIds.description: Ordered ids into the catalog's shared stops table.
